title: Local Bounti Looks to Expand National Footprint with Agreement to Purchase CEA Facilities in Temple, Texas and Medford, Minnesota

body_markdown:
*The acquisition is expected to close in the coming days and will add a new organic offering for Local Bounti's retail customers, supported by 30 acres of certified-organic greenhouse production*


HAMILTON, Mont.


, Nov. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Local Bounti Corporation (NYSE: LOCL) ("Local Bounti" or the "Company"), a breakthrough U.S. indoor agriculture company currently servicing approximately 13,000 retail doors, today announced that it has entered into an agreement to purchase Revol Greens' two certified-organic controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities located in Texas and Minnesota. The Texas facility spans 20 acres and the Minnesota facility spans 10 acres. Together, the 30 acres of certified-organic production will add a new capability and product offering for Local Bounti. The transaction will increase the Company's total growing capacity by roughly 70%, to approximately 73 acres, and is expected to close in the coming days, subject to customary closing conditions.


"We are excited to add these two facilities to our production footprint to meet growing customer demand," stated Kathleen Valiasek, President and CEO of Local Bounti. "Our existing capacity of approximately 43 acres is sold out. Buying rather than building has two clear advantages: speed to market and cost. First, we will be adding 30 acres of certified-organic greenhouse capacity that is already growing and selling to retailers, as we work toward our goal of being *Nationally Known, Locally Grown* . Second, the purchase price is considerably lower than the cost to build comparable new capacity, and the additional capacity is expected to be accretive to Local Bounti's earnings.


"Specifically, the Minnesota facility will expand our growing and distribution presence into the Midwest with a new local growing facility, which aligns with our previously communicated plans to enter this market and enables us to better serve customers in the region. In Texas, the facility will complement our existing presence in the region and provide us with additional capacity to service the large and growing Southern U.S. market where we've already built a network of growing and distribution operations that spans from California to Georgia.


"These facilities use growing processes that we've used in our existing network and fit naturally with our operations, with the potential to implement our patented Stack & Flow Technology® to drive future yield increases. Further, these facilities are certified organic, adding a new organic offering to our portfolio and allowing us to meet additional customer preferences. Retailers and consumers know and trust the Revol brand, and we look forward to building on that trust as we expand our national footprint."


Dirk Aleven, Chief Executive Officer of FoodVentures and President of Revol Greens, said, "Having operated these greenhouses day to day, I know what these facilities are capable of, and Local Bounti is the right home for them. Local Bounti brings the retail relationships and operating know-how to get the most out of these greenhouses and to serve customers close to where they shop. FoodVentures and DENSO are committed to the future of controlled environment agriculture, and we are pleased to support Local Bounti as it brings these facilities into its network."


FoodVentures, a Netherlands-based developer and operator of high-tech greenhouses and a stakeholder in Revol Greens, became a consolidated subsidiary of DENSO Corporation in 2026. DENSO, one of the world's largest automotive technology suppliers, has been building its agriculture business since 2017, including through its investment in greenhouse provider Certhon.


Both facilities use Deep Water Culture, a growing process Local Bounti already operates, and produce baby leaf products similar to its existing assortment, creating opportunities to increase product velocities with existing customers and pursue new retail and distribution opportunities. Both also bring established customer relationships, including new customers as well as existing Local Bounti customers across new distribution centers and regions, and have the flexibility to support head lettuce production in the future. Identified upgrades are expected to increase production per square foot by approximately 30%, with the potential to implement the Company's patented Stack & Flow Technology® over time.


The acquisition is also expected to include the Revol brand and related intellectual property.


**About Local Bounti**


Local Bounti is redefining indoor farming with an innovative method – its patented Stack & Flow Technology® – that significantly improves crop turns, increases output and improves unit economics. Local Bounti operates advanced indoor growing facilities across the United States, servicing approximately 13,000 retail doors. Local Bounti grows healthy food utilizing a hybrid approach that integrates the best attributes of controlled environment agriculture with natural elements. Local Bounti's sustainable growing methods are better for the planet, using 90% less land and 90% less water than conventional farming methods. With a mission to 'revolutionize agriculture, ensuring accessibility to fresh, sustainable, locally grown produce and nourishing communities everywhere for generations to come,' Local Bounti's food is fresher, more nutritious, and lasts longer than traditional agriculture.
